notes: Plate's right edge cuts Turrill Street's east side (about x 10400-10430); Turrill centres assume the printed 40 ft width. Chase Avenue lies on the top edge: its north side is off the plate, centre y from the south line (y 140) and the printed 60 ft. 'Palm ?' is a street entering Turrill from the east at y 2455-2600, only the letters PALM are on the plate. The east-west street at y 3300-3400 shows only the word STREET inside this strip; called Blue Rock Street from the plate description. It is 60 ft wide west of Cherry and printed 130 ft east of Cherry (north line steps north about 100 px), so the Cherry crossing centre is a compromise between centre y 3360 (west side) and 3328 (east side). McMakin Street (name printed west of the strip, about x 7950) ends at Delaney from the west and continues east of Delaney as McMakin Alley (12 ft) to Cherry; a second McMakin Alley, offset about 50 px south, runs from Cherry to Turrill. Cherry at Hoffner: one pick at the midpoint of the offset north and south legs. Turrill meets Hoffner only from the south. Powers Street: the east leg (y 7005) and the leg west of Colerain (running south-west, no name printed inside the strip, assumed Powers) meet Colerain at two separate points. Cooper Street's west end at Colerain is crossed by railroad tracks; Colerain centre there is extrapolated from its edges further south. Railroad crossing Cherry/Hoffner diagonally is not a street.
